logline: A washed-up climate engineer returns to a floating desalination city to stop a black-market water syndicate, only to discover her own past designs are powering the theft.
setting: A near-future floating desalination metropolis called BRINEHAVEN, built around massive intake towers and glittering algae farms. The wealthy live in sunlit upper rings; the working class in the damp lower floodways. Water is rationed, memories are edited by corporate therapists, and every drop is tracked by a ‘trust meter’.
invariants: The city is not fully destructible (no collapsing districts).
Water is always scarce; there is never a 'magic abundance' ending.
Deaths are reversible if you reach a clinic within 60 seconds.
Characters can be killed, but some are only downed temporarily.
Time travel is possible but only on Tuesdays.
